name: clipperzz-monorepo
description: Monorepo containing Frontend, Backend, and ModelService

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:model"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:model"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd Frontend && npm install && cd ../Backend && npm install && cd ../ModelService && npm install
